title: Mall World Survey
content: Ever wandered endlessly through a dream mall with strange corridors, hidden playgrounds, theme parks, or festival grounds and wondered if anyone else has too? I’m running an anonymous survey about recurring Mall World-type dreams, lucid dreaming, dream characters, and even experiences with psi phenomena. I’m also curious how programs like GATE or other cognitive-development experiences might connect. It only takes a few minutes, and your honest responses could help map the patterns of these unique dream worlds! https://www.jotform.com/assign/253274693296065/253496795061064 \* Please let me know if you have any trouble accessing this survey & feel free to share this on any of your social media platforms as I will also be sure to share the results I have collected with the community. Also, do not hesitate to share any additional questions for future follow up surveys as I’d be happy to include them in order for us to gather valuable insights and compile data on this.
